title: Pool of Tears

[[File:Pool of Tears.jpg|thumb|300px|Pool of Tears]]

The '''Pool of Tears''' is a large lake surrounded by marshland on the eastern side of the [[Swamp of Sorrows]]. After the construction of the [[Temple of Atal'Hakkar]], [[Ysera]] sunk the temple under the Pool's waters, where it still sits. Members of the [[green dragonflight]] cover the area nearby, watching over the corrupted temple. 

Blood-thirsty [[Frenzy|frenzies]] inhabit the water. Remains of [[Atal'ai]] ruins are scattered at the shore and underwater, where [[Atal'ai Artifact]]s can be found.
